about.heading: About
about.title: I like building things that have to work in front of people.
paragraphs: I'm Ethan, an Industrial Engineering student at the University of South Florida (Class of 2029). I'm from Columbus, Ohio, and I'm in Tampa for school.

I started with robots. In high school I led a three-person team to first place in a robotics competition, and in 2025 a partner and I built a 3-lb combat robot with zero budget, fixed it between matches, and went 4–1 at the National Robotics Challenge.

At USF, I joined Bulls Racing, our Formula SAE team. My first season was fabrication: carbon-fiber pedal faces and a lot of time inside the pedal box. This season I'm designing the steering system for the F27 car, with one goal: make it take less effort to turn the wheel than it did on F26.

I'm also the engineering consultant for syp, a student startup that measures how much athletes actually drink. I came up with how syp tracks a whole team at once, and I pitched it on stage at e-Fest, where we took second place for the Brand Builder Award.

Long-term, I want to lead engineering projects, ideally at a sports or hypercar manufacturer someday. For now I'm focused on learning how products are designed, built and improved, in whatever industry I'm working in.

games.heading: Games
games.title: Games I built
games.intro: Five party games for game night. A laptop runs them, a TV shows the big screen, and everyone plays on their own phone. Each one also has a version you can play right here: solo, against the computer, or passing one device around.

steps.title: The laptop hosts
steps.text: One command starts every game on my Mac.

steps.title: The TV shows the big screen
steps.text: Questions, drawings, races and the leaderboard.

steps.title: Phones are the controllers
steps.text: Friends scan a QR code. Nothing to install.

games.partyOnlyLabel: Game night only. It needs my laptop and everyone on the same Wi‑Fi.

items.name: Flappy Flock
items.tagline: Flappy Bird for a room full of phones.
items.description: Everyone shares one leaderboard, earns coins for 21 skins, and can race on the same pipes. The server replays every flight from the taps alone, so nobody can fake a score.
items.soloNote: Solo mode here. Your scores save on your device.

items.name: Plinko 32
items.tagline: 32 buckets, odds tilted toward the player.
items.description: Pick a risk level, set a bet, and drop. It has auto-drop strategies, trophies, ball skins, and at game night a shared leaderboard with chat.
items.soloNote: Solo mode here. Play money only, saved on your device.

items.name: Game Night Hub
items.tagline: One profile and one coin wallet for every game.
items.description: Starts all the games with one command, keeps a leaderboard for the whole night, runs side bets, and has Texas Hold'em with a TV poker table.
items.soloNote: Here: Texas Hold'em against 1 to 5 computer players, with play chips. Your best finish saves on your device.

items.name: Brain Brawl
items.description: Trivia, Fibber (fool your friends with a fake answer), Most Likely To, a buzzer Speed Round and a Final Wager.
items.soloNote: Solo version here: Trivia, Fibber, the Speed Round and the Final Wager against the clock. Your best score saves on your device.

items.name: Doodle Telephone
items.tagline: Write it, draw it, guess it.
items.description: Each idea passes from phone to phone. At the end the TV replays every chain stroke by stroke so the room can watch it fall apart.
items.soloNote: Pass-and-play here: 3 to 8 people share one phone, tablet or laptop. Names stay on that device.

roots.title: Two time zones

sections.heading: F27: designing the steering system
paragraphs: My first design role on the team. The goal is to bring steering torque below the 16 N·m measured on F26 and fix the steering compliance flagged in driver testing.
bullets: Stiffening the steering-column stabilizer against lateral deflection
Selecting the column bearings (F26 used press-fit bearings)
Choosing between a double-Cardan joint and two single U-joints so the column doesn't bind
Designing for roughly double the 4.44° of deflection measured on F26, for margin

paragraphs: My first season on the team was fabrication. The F26 car went on to place 19th of 111 teams at FSAE Michigan 2026.
bullets: Made the carbon-fiber pedal faces for the pedal box

projects.title: Senior design project: a flower cart
projects.summary: For my senior design project I built a rolling flower cart from scratch, with materials from around the house and from the store. I designed it to come apart for transport, and my sister's sorority uses it now.
projects.description: Ethan Baker's senior design project: a rolling flower cart built from scratch, with a welded steel base on casters and a wooden cabinet, designed to come apart for transport.

facts.label: Materials

sections.heading: The plan
paragraphs: I sketched a plan first, and designed the cart to come apart easily so it could be transported.

Built wooden frames with pocket screws and painted them white

Topped it with a gold frame, a pink and white striped canopy, and buckets for the flowers

projects.title: syp
projects.summary: syp measures how much athletes actually drink. I'm its engineering consultant: I came up with how it tracks a whole team at once, and I help pitch it.
projects.description: Ethan Baker's work as engineering consultant for syp, a student hydration-tech startup: its team tracking system and its pitch competitions.

results.label: Brand Builder Award, e-Fest 2026, as one of 25 finalist teams from nearly 170 ventures
U.S. finalists, Alibaba.com CoCreate Pitch 2026, from 39,000+ applicants

sections.heading: Tracking a whole team
paragraphs: I came up with syp's team-integration system: RFID wristbands on the players and an antenna in the bottle. Each drink is matched to the athlete who took it and shows up live on the coach's dashboard.

sections.heading: Design drawings
paragraphs: I drafted the design drawings for syp's multi-size variant. A teammate built the CAD model from them.

sections.heading: Pitching
paragraphs: I'm one of two people who present syp's business plan.
bullets: e-Fest 2026, Minneapolis: I pitched on stage to the judges, and syp took 2nd place for the Brand Builder Award.
Alibaba.com CoCreate Pitch 2026: I worked on our application. syp was one of 20 U.S. finalists and received the $10,000 finalist award. The team pitched the final in Los Angeles.
USF Business Plan Championship, October 2, 2026: I pitched syp's business plan with a teammate.
